# .github/pull_request_template.md

## Type of Change

- [ ] `content`: New content project
- [ ] `feat`: New platform feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `style`: UI/UX improvement
